semantics.bootstrap: 95% interval from 1000 size-n resamples of the trimmed harmonic mean; Python Random seed 42
semantics.classification: ratio endpoints changed.low/baseline.high to changed.high/baseline.low; all three methods must confirm point direction
semantics.iqr: linear p25 to p75 of untrimmed samples
semantics.point_estimator: harmonic mean after dropping the lowest max(1, floor(10%*n)) samples
semantics.sample_unit: per-instance isolated-iteration arithmetic mean across parallel prompts
semantics.t_interval: 95% log-space interval for geometric mean; t critical through df=49, 1.96 thereafter
